metas.name: ★ 8.6 · 1997 · Life Is Beautiful
metas.description: When an open-minded Jewish waiter and his son become victims of the Holocaust, he uses a perfect mixture of will, humor and imagination to protect his son from the dangers around their camp.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1985 · Back to the Future
metas.description: Marty McFly, a 17-year-old high school student, is accidentally sent 30 years into the past in a time-traveling DeLorean invented by his close friend, the maverick scientist Doc Brown.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2011 · The Intouchables
metas.description: After he becomes a quadriplegic from a paragliding accident, an aristocrat hires a young man from the projects to be his caregiver.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1936 · Modern Times
metas.description: The Tramp struggles to live in modern industrial society with the help of a young homeless woman.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 1931 · City Lights
metas.description: With the aid of a wealthy erratic tippler, a dewy-eyed tramp who has fallen in love with a blind flower girl accumulates money to be able to help her medically.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2009 · 3 Idiots
metas.description: Two friends are searching for their long lost companion. They revisit their college days and recall the memories of their friend who inspired them to think differently, even as the rest of the world called them "idiots".

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1940 · The Great Dictator
metas.description: Dictator Adenoid Hynkel tries to expand his empire while a poor Jewish barber tries to avoid persecution from Hynkel's regime.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2009 · Up
metas.description: 78-year-old Carl Fredricksen travels to South America in his house equipped with balloons, inadvertently taking a young stowaway.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1995 · Toy Story
metas.description: A cowboy doll is profoundly jealous when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as the top toy in a boy's bedroom. When circumstances separate them from their owner, the duo have to put aside their differences to return to him.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2010 · Toy Story 3
metas.description: As Andy prepares to leave for college, Woody, Buzz and the gang face an uncertain future when a mix-up sends them to a daycare center full of new toys.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1964 · Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
metas.description: A mentally unstable American general orders a hydrogen bomb attack on the Soviet Union, triggering a path to global nuclear holocaust that a war room full of politicians and generals frantically tries to stop.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1952 · Singin' in the Rain
metas.description: A silent film star falls for a chorus girl just as he and his delusionally jealous screen partner are trying to make the difficult transition to talking pictures in 1920s Hollywood.
